title: WORLD WAR II: A GLOBAL HISTORY
description: Examines World War II from a global perspective, its origins, the course of the conflict and its aftermath, looking especially at the US, USSR, Britain, Germany and Japan. Topics will include the concept of total war and the home fronts of a number of nations.
books_html: Low-cost:  Course material total cost is $40 or less.
